decisions.reason: The Hero V remains the geometry source for the closing V. Refining the Hero V's arm character and vertex relationship does not alter the closing V's existing derivation requirement.
The source changes only the Hero V's arms and vertex during exploration; it does not change the deferred construction requirements for the E and L letterforms.
The É accent's requirement to derive from Hero V geometry remains valid unchanged; the source does not specify a new accent correspondence or derivation rule.
The source concerns black-and-white structural character of the Hero V and makes no decision about the deferred champagne material treatment.
Exploration of the Hero V's arm and vertex geometry does not change the deferred requirement for cohesive wordmark kerning and rhythm.
The source contains design feedback about Hero V geometry and does not change accepted review-image formats or file accessibility requirements.
